scope: Primary sources inspected by the coordinating reviewer; overlapping Mensh-Kording reading is counted in the writing-primary inventory only.

sources.title: Research Debt
sources.inspected: Complete extracted essay, including The Debt, Interpretive Labor, Clear Thinking, and Research Distillation; illustrations were not visually inspected.
sources.takeaway: Treat explanatory design as substantive work: improve representations and notation so the reader performs less reconstruction. Use a fresh reader to find missing conceptual steps.
sources.limit: An essay about research communication, not experimental evidence that a workflow improves acceptance. The skill does not adopt its specific analogies or require interactive publication.
sources.license_observed: CC BY 4.0 for article text/diagrams except separately attributed reused material; no source material redistributed.

sources.title: Preparing figures - our specifications
sources.inspected: Full extracted specifications: graphs, images, text, and export; explanatory images not visually inspected.
sources.takeaway: Check units, text legibility, contrast, and editable exports at final display size.
sources.limit: Nature-specific font sizes, typography, file rules, and image resolutions must not be imported as AI-conference rules. Existing skill already covers most transferable guidance.

sources.title: Building and exporting figure panels
sources.inspected: Full extracted text, especially panel arrangement, accessibility, and export; illustration appearance not assessed.
sources.takeaway: Allocate panel area according to content and legibility, and use explicit keys and text labels that remain understandable without color names alone.
sources.limit: This is one publisher's guide, not a universal prescription for font sizes, chart styles, or accepted files.

sources.title: Image Integrity
sources.inspected: Full extracted text; Preparing images and image-transform restrictions relevant to this comparison.
sources.takeaway: Transformations, composites, repeated panels, and generated illustrations must be checked against the target's rules and faithful data presentation.
sources.limit: The Nature page's generative-figure restriction belongs to that publisher. Do not misstate it as an all-conference ban or general permission. No biological image workflow is added to the skill.
